chunks: And God has provided for you mates from among yourselves, and has granted you sons and grandsons from your mates, and has given you sustenance from the good things. Will they then believe in falsehood and deny the grace of God?
ai.seo_question: What are the specific blessings of family and sustenance mentioned in Surah An-Nahl verse 72?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to validate the natural institution of marriage and the continuity of lineage as divine signs (ayat) of God's mercy. It underscores the logical inconsistency of idolaters who acknowledge material blessings yet reject the Creator, a theme that resonates with the concept of fitrah (innate disposition) recognizing God through His creations.
